room_rent.note: Proportionate deduction on other expenses (except medicines) if room taken above entitled limit

icu.note: Proportionate deduction applies if ICU charges exceed limit

copayment.note: 20% co-payment on all claims; can be waived by paying additional 25% premium

sub_limits.note: Cataract: 25% of SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year (whichever lower); Modern treatments: up to 50% of SI

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing disability covered under policy has 24-month waiting period; all other PEDs 36 months

specific_disease_waiting.note: Hernia, hydrocele, cataract, hysterectomy, benign ENT disorders, varicose veins, calculi, internal congenital anomalies, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative bonus mentioned in the policy wording

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy

day_care.note: Indicative list of 537 day-care procedures provided in Annexure V

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation expenses explicitly excluded under specific exclusions

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment in recognised AYUSH hospitals covered up to full SI

organ_donor.note: Hospitalisation for donation of body organs by insured explicitly excluded

ambulance.note: Road ambulance only; requires accepted inpatient claim

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemo, etc.) covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical/consumable items excluded under Annexure IV

global_cover.note: Any medical treatment taken outside India is explicitly excluded

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud and permanent exclusions

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium payment mode; 30 days for all other modes

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only, not on renewals

portability.note: As per IRDAI portability guidelines; continuity credit for waiting periods transferred

notable_exclusions: Treatment outside India, organ donor hospitalisation, domiciliary treatment, STDs (except HIV/AIDS), stem cell storage, alternative medicine (except AYUSH), anti-retroviral therapy
